gauntlet.intent: Hard-case replay of FIXED defect BUG-losses-scoring-side-unaware (signature: enemy-kill-credited-to-own-side). Detection is deliberately reciprocal (blue observes red AND red observes blue, including one air-vs-air pair) with WeaponsFree both sides and a moderate-elevated pkKill (0.55, above the tier baseline ~0.2-0.25) so BOTH sides reliably land at least one kill across the 10-tick window, not just blue. Post-fix, BLUE's reported kills must only count outcomes where the shooter was a BLUE unit -- RED's kill(s) against BLUE hulls must NOT inflate BLUE's tally. A side-unaware scorer (the pre-fix behaviour) would report a higher BLUE kill count than the number of RED units actually destroyed. Deliberately WeaponsFree/WeaponsFree both sides and no passive-EMCON stand-in in THIS candidate -- the tier's ROE-tight/passive-EMCON asymmetry coverage is carried by candidates 3-4 instead, isolating the side-aware-scoring variable per the one-focused-mutation-family guidance.
gauntlet.oracle: Both BLUE and RED score at least one Kill-coded engagement outcome; BLUE's reported kills count strictly excludes outcomes fired by RED shooters (i.e. BLUE kills <= number of RED units actually destroyed, never inflated by RED-on-BLUE kills).
